purpose: A market-free college-football challenger that adds causal efficiency, opponent adjustment, roster continuity, talent, quarterback and travel context to the validated CFB v1 state model.

incumbent.known_strength: Validated home-win probability and margin in the recovered historical CFB implementation.
known_limitations: Most aggregate home-win gain over causal Elo comes from FBS-versus-FCS games.
On FBS-versus-FBS games v1 is approximately tied with evaluation-only ESPN pregame Elo.
The v1 total target is NOT_VALIDATED_VS_BASELINE.
Historical causal injuries and depth charts are unavailable, so v1 personnel is context-only.

competition_scope.rule: The cohorts are fit, calibrated, reported and promoted separately. Aggregate improvement may not conceal a failed FBS-versus-FBS cohort.

source_plan.role: Authoritative cache of raw ESPN CFB schedules and per-game payloads
Offline-reprocessable per-game JSON enriched with EPA, WPA and advanced box-score fields
Analysis-ready seasonal tables reshaped from the enriched per-game JSON
GitHub release host for the versioned espn_cfb_* seasonal tables
Versioned client for optional talent, recruiting, returning-production and transfer inputs
source_plan.missing_behavior: Disable the entire optional feature block; never synthesize or silently median-impute a structurally missing season.

source_binding.same_family_warning: Raw and parsed SportsDataverse repositories are correlated evidence and do not constitute independent result confirmation.

causal_rules.game_features: Only games with final event time strictly before the target kickoff may update team state.
causal_rules.weekly_block: All games in one official season-week share the same training and feature cutoff.
causal_rules.season_openers: Prior-season efficiency is regressed toward the subdivision mean; current-season information cannot be backfilled after kickoff.
causal_rules.personnel: A personnel value is predictive only when an historically retained pregame artifact exists. Current-only roster knowledge is context or a registered replacement input, never retrofitted into training.
causal_rules.market: Prices, spreads, totals, consensus, rankings derived from betting markets and public betting percentages are excluded from all model features and tuning.

home_win.calibration: Nested expanding-window isotonic calibration fitted only on prior out-of-fold predictions; sigmoid fallback when the calibration block is insufficient.

walk_forward.training_cutoff: strictly before the earliest kickoff in the evaluation week
walk_forward.hyperparameter_selection: Tune on seasons through evaluation_season-2 and validate on evaluation_season-1; selected values are fixed through the evaluation season.
walk_forward.multiplicity: Holm correction across registered primary target comparisons

baselines.external_diagnostic_only: ESPN pregame Elo or predictor when retained before kickoff; never treated as an internally controlled baseline.

home_win: Lower Brier than every registered internal baseline on FBS_VS_FBS.
Holm-adjusted 95% paired season-week interval versus the strongest baseline excludes zero in the improving direction.
Calibration slope between 0.85 and 1.15 and absolute calibration intercept no greater than 0.10.
No single season contributes more than 35% of the total paired improvement.
home_margin: Lower MAE than both registered margin baselines on FBS_VS_FBS.
Holm-adjusted 95% paired season-week interval excludes zero in the improving direction.
total_points: Remains disabled unless it independently clears both total baselines and its paired interval gate.
promotion_gates.prospective: Historical OOF validation may authorize a prospective shadow challenger, never real-money action. Promotion also requires the registered live horizon.

week_one_policy.reason: Roster turnover, transfers, quarterback changes and coaching changes make Week 1 materially different from ordinary in-season forecasting.
week_one_policy.missing_behavior: Publish v1 baseline forecasts and V2_INPUT_BLOCKED; do not pretend prior-season team form is a complete Week 1 state.
week_one_policy.fbs_fcs_extreme_spread_review: Any model-market spread disagreement greater than 14 points is AUDIT_REQUIRED and cannot become a candidate without source and roster review.
